[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Ezekiel was born in 1767. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2868|James Glasgow]] and [[Hartshorne-320|Ann Hartshorne]]. He passed away in 1780.

== Research Notes ==

The Charlestown letter-list James/Ezekiel adjacency supplies no additional kinship proof.

=== Possible Ezekiel Glasgow, Charlestown postal addressee, 1775 ===
James Glasgow and Ezekiel Glasgow appear in the list of letters remaining in Charlestown’s General Post Office, dated 21 August 1775.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/605068969/ The South-Carolina and American General Gazette, 1775-08-25, p.1].</ref>

The postal list gives neither an age nor a family relationship between James and Ezekiel. An addressee need not have been an adult or resident at the post office.

This may concern [[Glasgow-3293]]. Birth 1767, Cecil County, Maryland, uncertain; death 1780, place blank, uncertain. A child-age addressee is possible in principle, but the Maryland profile has no Charleston connection and the uncertain lifespan is not a secure exclusion. The recorded listed parent James Glasgow (Glasgow-2868) is unassessed/tree-derived; the newspaper's co-listed James is not proved to be that father.
